SELECT 
    AVG(t1.ball_control) FILTER (WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') - 
    AVG(t1.ball_control) FILTER (WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS diff_avg_ball_control
FROM Player_Attributes t1
JOIN Player p ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')
